{{Quote|This is Elrood Space Central. Welcome to Elrood. Please turn to channel XTX984 for instructions.|Standard message to starships entering Elrood system|<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>}}
'''Channel XTX984''' was the standard communications channel required for all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to interact with [[Elrood Starport Command]].
